skins.name: Spellbreaker
skins.description: A Laterano dress with corresponding weapons. Generally, only Sankta who have presided over the ceremonies are allowed to wear it, and Mostima seems to have quietly snuck out with this outfit.

skins.name: Lasting Arrowroot
skins.description: Made with special materials and designed to be functional, perfect for coping with various needs and weathering even the roughest outdoor conditions.

skins.name: Light and Shadow
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Light and Shadow
skins.description: A trendy, vintage Victorian appeal, modified to Nightmare's specifications. Some decorative elements will change when Nightmare's personality shifts.

skins.name: Starseeker
skins.description: One of the intricate outfits worn by Astesia only in the grandest occasions of Columbia 's social life. Merely donning this outfit is a statement of its own.
